collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART VI (101-120, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: Once a villager notices one spiral, they see spirals everywhere: show a friend, or draw them all.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: It started with a shell. (subject) noticed the spiral on it, curling round and round into the middle. Then (subject.he/she) noticed the same spiral in a fern unrolling. Then in the middle of a flower. Then in the water going round in a little whirlpool by the rocks. Now (subject.he/she) sees spirals everywhere, and (subject.he/she) can't stop.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) takes (friend) on a tour of spirals: shell, fern, flower, whirlpool, the curl of a snail, the pattern on a pinecone. "Why do so many things do it?" (subject) asks. (friend) doesn't know. Neither does (subject). They both walk home staring at everything, and (friend) trips over a root that is, (friend.he/she) swears, slightly spiral.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) spends the evening drawing every spiral (subject.he/she) found, one after another, on a big piece of bark. They're not the same, exactly. But they're all cousins, somehow. (subject.He/She) doesn't understand it. (subject.He/She) pins the bark up on the wall anyway, where (subject.he/she) can look at it.
